About Us

Since 1993, Blue Ribbon Painting & Decorating, Inc. has been the go-to painting contractor for homeowners and businesses throughout Naperville, Elmhurst, Downers Grove, and Lombard, IL. Locally owned and operated, we specialize in delivering high-quality interior painting, residential painting, commercial projects, and drywall repair all with a strong focus on professionalism, safety, and craftsmanship.

We’re proud to be a fully licensed and insured company, backed by over three decades of experience and a long-standing commitment to integrity. Whether you're refreshing a single room or transforming a full commercial space, we’re here to help you bring color, comfort, and value to every surface.

Why Quality Painting Services Matter

A fresh coat of paint does more than improve appearance  it boosts mood, protects surfaces, and enhances your property's long-term value. Whether you're preparing your home for sale or just moved into a new office, professional painting:

Creates a clean, modern look

Covers scuffs, stains, or damage

Protects drywall from moisture and wear

Enhances lighting and ambiance

Enhances lighting and ambiance﻿

At Blue Ribbon Painting, we believe every space deserves to look its best — and we deliver results that last.

Why Choose Blue Ribbon Painting?
Trusted Since 1993


We’ve proudly served the western suburbs for over 30 years, building relationships with homeowners and businesses.﻿

Fully Insured


We carry up to $2,000,000 in liability insurance for your protection, and all painters are background-checked.

Brand-Name Products


We use premium, name-brand paints on every job to ensure beautiful results and lasting durability.﻿

Our Core Painting Services

View Services
Residential Painting


Turn your house into a home with crisp, vibrant colors. We make every space shine.﻿

Commercial Painting


Fast, professional painting for offices and retail with minimal disruption.

Interior Painting


Refresh any room with smooth, even coats that enhance light, mood, and energy.﻿

Drywall Repair


We repair dents, cracks, and holes before painting to ensure a flawless finish.﻿

What Our Customers Are Saying

We’re proud to be one of the most trusted painting companies in Naperville with repeat clients and referrals as the core of our business.

Frequently Asked Questions﻿
Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. We provide no-obligation estimates for all residential and commercial projects.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Naperville, Lombard, Elmhurst, Downers Grove, and most of DuPage County.

Are your painters insured and background-checked?

Absolutely. Every crew member passes a criminal background check and is covered by our insurance.

Do you help with color selection?

Yes, we offer paint consultations to help you pick the perfect shades for your space.

Do you use eco-friendly or low-VOC paints?

Yes. Upon request, we can use low-VOC or environmentally friendly paint products that are safe for kids and pets.

Ready to Refresh Your Space?﻿

Don’t settle for less when it comes to your home or business. With professional service, premium products, and decades of experience, Blue Ribbon Painting & Decorating, Inc. is the clear choice in Naperville and beyond.
